title: Maxima of Coxeter frieze patterns are Fibonacci numbers
abstract: Formalizes the claim that the sequence of maxima of values of (Coxeter) arithmetic frieze patterns is the Fibonacci sequence, using a correspondence between arithmetic frieze patterns and n-flutes.

informal.main3: Proves that the maximum value of an arithmetic frieze pattern of width n is exactly the n-th Fibonacci number, and that this bound is attained.
informal.FluteBounded: Proves that every entry of an n-flute is bounded above by the n-th Fibonacci number.
informal.glideSymm: Proves the glide-reflection symmetry of Coxeter frieze patterns.
informal.translationInvariance: Proves the (n+1)-periodicity (horizontal translation invariance) of Coxeter frieze patterns.
